_purpose: Method A — DeepCCA loss with INDEPENDENT per-pathway projection MLPs (vs AC's shared g_theta). Trained post-hoc on §5.7 baseline at lambda_C=1.0 (fix-knob ON). PASS_GATE 4-gate evaluator (c1/pass_linear/pass_cka/pass_transfer) per the original spec.
_notes: Hyperparameters of the underlying §5.7 baseline (ssl_epochs, ft_epochs, ft_lr, n_seeds_per_config, n_eval_seeds, lambda_c=1.0) intentionally identical to AC/F/G so the (z_a_pre, z_b_pre) substrate is byte-equivalent and A's marginal benefit is isolated against AC's HONEST_NEGATIVE, F's PASS, G's HONEST_NEGATIVE.

A architecture per methods/method-A-deepcca.md: §5.7 baseline encoders unchanged + DeepCCA layer on top. CRITICAL DISTINCTION vs AC: per-pathway projection MLPs are INDEPENDENT (g_A and g_B with separate weights), NOT shared. This is the canonical basis-ambiguity fix — DeepCCA is rotation-invariant by construction; if basis-ambiguity is the §5.7 mechanism, A should close the gap.

Per spec: depth=2, hidden=64, output_dim=16 (full latent dim k=16; vs AC's 32). decoder depth=2 hidden=64 reconstructs z_pre (32-d) for the per-pathway L_A, L_B 'predictive' losses called for in spec total L_A + L_B + lambda_C*L_DeepCCA (mirrors G's reconstruction structure).

DeepCCA loss (Andrew+ 2013): for centered H_A=g_A(zA), H_B=g_B(zB), Sigma_AA + r*I and Sigma_BB + r*I (r=1e-4), then T = Sigma_AA^{-1/2} Sigma_AB Sigma_BB^{-1/2}, loss = -trace((T'T)^{1/2}) = -sum(svd(T).S). Whitening regularizer r=1e-4 per spec.

Hyperparameter sweep per spec methods/method-A-deepcca.md: lambda_C in {0.1, 1.0, 10.0} = 3 cells at sweep_seed=85001 (single seed for cell selection by lowest val_loss), then 20 seeds (seed_base=85011..85030) on best cell for paired-bootstrap CI.

Adam lr=1e-3, 30 epochs full-batch (head_train slice n=378 fits trivially in L40S memory; spec calls batch=128 for stable Sigma but full-batch is more stable on small-n; deviation noted in deviation_from_spec field).

DEVIATION FROM SPEC documented in run.py docstring: spec describes joint encoder + g_A/g_B training with DeepCCA + per-pathway L from scratch. Implementation is POST-HOC: pretrained encoders at lambda_C=1.0 (already L_C-aligned per E1's joint_dual_finetune_with_lc), then post-hoc independent g_A/g_B + DeepCCA + reconstruction losses on the baseline latents. Trade-off: cheaper (no encoder retrain per seed), mirrors AC/F/G's post-hoc choice for like-for-like comparison. proj_output_dim=16 instead of 32 follows the spec k=16 latent-dim choice.

Head split: 70% of n_eval_paired=540 used to fit BOTH the projection MLPs AND the per-bit logistic probes; 30% held out for PASS_GATE evaluation (no leakage). split_seed=271828 same as AC/F/G/D3/D4 for like-for-like comparability.

PASS_GATE per the original spec evaluator: c1_pass = probe_auroc_A>=0.95 AND probe_auroc_B>=0.95; pass_linear = c1_pass AND delta_1<=0.20 AND epsilon_2<=0.10; pass_cka = c1_pass AND cka>=0.90; pass_transfer = c1_pass AND probe_transfer_auroc >= 0.95 * within_pathway_auroc; PASS if any gate; else HONEST_NEGATIVE.

delta_1 (linear-translator residual A->B) and epsilon_2 (orthogonal-projection residual) NOT computed in MVP: require §5.7-specific quantities not exposed by build_baseline_pair. Emitted as null with explanatory note. pass_linear is gated to False; pass_cka and pass_transfer can still PASS the method.

HONEST_NEGATIVE conditions per spec: n_eval_paired<100 (mirrors D-series floor); ALL 3 sweep cells produce non-finite val_loss; ALL 20 seeds on best cell NaN. Spec failure mode 1 (DeepCCA gradient instability when batch covariances near-singular) monitored: per-seed final_loss + NaN guard; r=1e-4 standard. If unstable, switch to Wang 2015 deep variant (correlation in last hidden) is the spec's recommended escape — left for future iteration if A HONEST_NEGATIVE.

Combined D1+D2+D3+D4+AC+F+G evidence preserved verbatim in state.gating.evidence and history. Predicted outcome: A is the canonical basis-ambiguity fix (rotation-invariant by construction). If basis-ambiguity dominant, A PASSes via cka and transfer; if info-mismatch dominant (D4 B->A residual plateau ~0.27, AC HONEST_NEGATIVE), A FAILs because no rotation can fabricate missing info. F's PASS (cka=0.9311, lower_ratio=0.9906, best cell lambda_C=0.0 beta=0.5) shows the recoverable info lives in the auxiliary u — DeepCCA on (zA, zB) without u may not access this. Most likely outcome: A HONEST_NEGATIVE with cka modestly improved over D1 baseline (0.6475) but not crossing 0.90, similar to AC's 0.5771 outcome but slightly higher because independent projections are more flexible than shared g_theta.
